transferProblems.problem: A packed candidate contains the expected Swift source and desktop tests pass, but no iOS host command receipt exists. Classify every proven and unproven boundary.
transferProblems.answer: Distribution and desktop boundaries pass; iOS native registration, command return, and capability denial remain unproven and block stable mobile certification.

transferProblems.problem: A fresh Cargo target build passes but generated-bindings.ts differs after regeneration. Decide whether the release gate can pass and identify the corrective evidence.
transferProblems.answer: No. The source-to-binding drift gate fails. Regenerate the binding, review and retain the candidate output, then rerun the generator in check mode until it reports no drift.
